perimeter-shapes-skill-01.target: I can find the perimeter of a polygon by adding all of its side lengths, including sides that are not labeled.
perimeter-shapes-skill-01.ifCorrect: You can do this: can find the perimeter of a polygon by adding all of its side lengths, including sides that are not labeled.
perimeter-shapes-skill-01.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Adding only the labeled sides of a rectangle, or counting the unit squares inside (area). Try this: Trace the outside with a finger and check off each side as you add it.

perimeter-shapes-skill-02.target: I can find an unknown side length when I know the perimeter and the other side lengths.
perimeter-shapes-skill-02.ifCorrect: You can do this: can find an unknown side length when I know the perimeter and the other side lengths.
perimeter-shapes-skill-02.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Subtracting only one side from the perimeter, or dividing the perimeter by the number of sides for a shape that is not regular. Try this: Add the known sides first, then subtract that sum from the perimeter; check by adding all sides.

perimeter-shapes-skill-03.target: I can draw and compare rectangles that have the same perimeter and different areas, or the same area and different perimeters.
perimeter-shapes-skill-03.ifCorrect: You can do this: can draw and compare rectangles that have the same perimeter and different areas, or the same area and different perimeters.
perimeter-shapes-skill-03.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Thinking that rectangles with the same perimeter must have the same area. Try this: List all the rectangles with a given perimeter in a table and find each area.

perimeter-shapes-skill-04.target: I can sort shapes by their attributes and explain that rhombuses, rectangles, and squares are all quadrilaterals.
perimeter-shapes-skill-04.ifCorrect: You can do this: can sort shapes by their attributes and explain that rhombuses, rectangles, and squares are all quadrilaterals.
perimeter-shapes-skill-04.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Thinking a square is not a rectangle or a rhombus, or that every quadrilateral is one of these. Try this: Use an attribute checklist (4 sides, 4 right angles, 4 equal sides) and check every box for each shape.

perimeter-shapes-skill-05.target: I can partition a shape into parts with equal area and name the area of each part as a unit fraction of the whole.
perimeter-shapes-skill-05.ifCorrect: You can do this: can partition a shape into parts with equal area and name the area of each part as a unit fraction of the whole.
perimeter-shapes-skill-05.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Thinking parts must be the same shape to have equal area, or naming unequal parts with a unit fraction. Try this: Count the unit squares in each part on grid paper to check that the areas are equal.
